mechanism: Unselected same-class zero-target denominator rows have positive score cotangents and can push down same-class similarity.

proposed_retained_set: Original fixed selected positives union all different-class panel rows, for each original anchor direction.
gradient_qualification: Exclusion zeros direct excluded-row score cotangents and renormalizes every retained cotangent; it is not merely deleting gradient slices.
local_CE_condition: For common Euclidean step eta, masked-minus-full first-order CE change is eta*alpha*dot(grad F,grad R_mean); helps when the dot product is negative.
representative_conditional_contrast: Original shared ROUTE with complete denominator

principal_failure_modes: Useful subclass discrimination or regularization removed
